lead: Cinematic horror film still at night, grey concrete, crimson flesh, sodium amber light.
notes: Mood-only mini images for RussiBiomonster.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen RussiBiomonster-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish RussiBiomonster-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.
